sections.label: Automation improves agency efficiency
sections.summary: Automation has helped many agencies improve work efficiency and effectiveness, producing manpower and cost savings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Automation has helped many agencies improve work efficiency and effectiveness, resulting in manpower and cost savings.

sections.label: Automation examples in agencies
sections.summary: AutoSorter, LTA drones and ICA automated motorcycle counters are cited as automation yielding savings, time reduction and officer redeployment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The AutoSorter piloted in Sembawang Public Library sorts about 2,500 items a day, a task which would otherwise require at least one person to complete.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: After this automation is rolled out to all 26 public libraries by 2018, NLB expects to save $780,000 per year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has found that using drones to take aerial photographs at its construction sites, to monitor and track progress has reduced the time taken by 75%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Since end-2016, the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) has equipped all motorcycle counters at the Woodlands and Tuas checkpoints with automated capabilities to clear eligible motorcyclists and pillion riders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: They now enjoy about 30% faster clearance, and ICA is also able to redeploy at least 60 officers from the manual counters to other roles.

sections.label: Public sector labour force share
sections.summary: The public sector's share of the total labour force fell from 4.3% in 2006 to 4% in 2016, one of the lowest internationally.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In terms of the public sector's share of the total labour force, it has decreased from 4.3% in 2006 to 4% in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This is one of the lowest internationally, and is lower than in countries, such as Korea, 7.4%; New Zealand, 11.5%; and the United Kingdom, 21.4%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This has been a result of policies to constrain our public sector manpower growth, and efforts to leverage technology, including automation.
